## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a fair young woman known for her showy looks, lovely long golden hair worn in yellow braids, and large, bright blue eyes. Originally characterized by a brilliant complexion and a plump figure, her appearance later becomes very thin. In addition, her blue eyes take on a bright, lustrous quality while her cheek color becomes hectically brilliant.

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is also prone to hysterics. She is heavily focused on young men and boys, driven by a long-held motivation to attract dozens of suitors and enjoy a very gay time before marrying. Her practical plans include teaching for only two years before settling down into marriage. In terms of fears, she harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars and has expressed a deep fear of dying.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), having famously charmed away all her warts with a magic pebble as a child. A member of Anne's childhood story club, Ruby declared early on that she intended to have many suitors when she grew up. She attended school alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), eventually progressing with her to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) to train as a teacher. Following their time at Queen's, Ruby gained a reputation for lively social chatter and flirtatious behavior back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). However, she later fell terminally ill with consumption. Though she initially hid her failing health behind a façade of gaiety, Ruby eventually confided her deep fear of dying and her desire to live during an emotional evening with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Shortly after that conversation, Ruby passed away peacefully in her sleep, leaving her friends to mourn her loss.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "It makes me feel frightened, girls. Do you suppose it’s really right to act like this? Mrs. Lynde says that all play-acting is abominably wicked."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I’ll try. I’ll think over what you have said, and try to believe it. And you’ll come up as often as you can, won’t you, Anne?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)
